fusions.name: Shed Teeth
fusions.desc: Spits 3 teeth in a spread, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance of [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Left Behind
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A bite that deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Humming Mound
fusions.desc: Raises a nest mound beside you for 12 seconds that stings the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Ceaseless Bites
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
